name: npm-carrier
//: The npm carrier package (its JS launcher, postinstall and platform resolver, with their node:test suite). This project.json sits beside the carrier's package.json because that package is an npm workspace member, which Nx infers as a project of its own; the two merge here (Nx also infers a `postinstall` target from its scripts, which no gate recipe names). It depends on terminal-approval because it distributes that crate's binary — and because terminal-approval, as the root project, owns the files the carrier's release path reads outside this directory: the per-platform binary packages beside it and scripts/{stage-npm-package,set-npm-package-version}.mjs and scripts/smoke-npm-package.sh. Nx selects affected projects by file ownership, not inputs, so this edge is what reruns the carrier's suite when those change. A change inside this directory reaches only this project.

test.//: The root package.json's `test` script — the one definition of the carrier's suite, which the install-smoke job runs too.
